architecture_summary: Modular React SPA. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state management lib (useState/useReducer suffice).

tickets.title: Landing hero page component (src/pages/HeroLanding.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React. Extract reusable HeroText, HeroImage components. Preserve exact layout, typography, animations. Use Tailwind classes from design tokens.

tickets.title: Showcase explore section (src/pages/ShowcaseExplore.jsx)
tickets.description: Build showcase grid. Extract ProjectCard component. Implement hover states, lazy loading for images. Use CSS Grid for layout.
acceptance_criteria: Hover effects trigger on desktop, tap on mobile
Accessible alt text for all images

tickets.title: Services & projects page (src/pages/ServicesProjects.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert services accordion and projects timeline. Extract AccordionItem, TimelineItem components. Preserve animation curves from design.

tickets.title: Marquee about section (src/pages/MarqueeAbout.jsx)
tickets.description: Implement infinite marquee text. Extract MarqueeText component. Use CSS animation for scroll effect. Preserve speed, pause on hover.

tickets.title: Collection footer section (src/pages/CollectionFooter.jsx)
tickets.description: Build footer with social links, newsletter form. Extract NewsletterForm component. Validate email input client-side.
acceptance_criteria: Email validation matches design error states
Social links open in new tab

tickets.title: Shared layout components (src/components/Layout.jsx)
tickets.description: Create shared layout wrapper. Include header, footer, scroll-to-top button. Use React context for theme if dark mode present in future screens.

tickets.title: Design system tokens (src/styles/tokens.js)
tickets.description: Extract design tokens from Stitch screens. Colors, spacing, typography, shadows. Export as JS object for Tailwind config and direct use.
acceptance_criteria: All colors match design hex values
Typography tokens include font family, weight, size, line height

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Set up React Router. Create route config for all pages. Implement navigation bar with active state. Lazy-load page components. Add 404 fallback.
acceptance_criteria: All routes load correct page component
Lazy-loaded chunks load without layout shift
